events.headline: Steelers rout Denver 27-5 on Black Friday behind two defensive touchdowns; Mason Rudolph throws for 142 yards in his first start since the Rodgers release
events.detail: Rudolph went 9 of 15 for 142 yards with a 22-yard touchdown to DK Metcalf. Rico Dowdle ran 11 times for 71 yards, and he and Jaylen Warren combined for 117 rushing yards; Warren was tackled in the end zone for Denver's only points, a safety. Bo Nix finished 22 of 40 for 169 yards with two interceptions and a lost fumble, and T.J. Watt (fumble recovery) and Jalen Ramsey (pick-six) scored. Denver gained 178 total yards.
events.so_what: Pittsburgh's defense hit the top of the scoring table: a 5-point allowance plus two defensive scores is close to the ceiling of the points-allowed tiers. Rudolph threw only 15 passes, so treat the Steelers as a run-first offense; Metcalf stays a TD-dependent start. Two INTs at -1 and a lost fumble at -2 sank Nix's week; one bad game is not a benching on its own.

source.label: ESPN: Steelers use inspired defensive performance to overwhelm Broncos (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Juwan Johnson (hamstring, wrist) ruled out vs. Cincinnati; Noah Fant added Friday as Questionable with a calf injury
events.detail: Johnson missed all three practices and is out for Sunday, per WWL. Fant was a late addition Friday, limited with a calf injury and listed Questionable, leaving Oscar Delp as the only healthy active tight end; Treyton Welch could be elevated.
events.so_what: Neither New Orleans tight end is a safe start: Johnson is out and Fant is a Friday add with a limited session. Only stream Fant in a deep pinch and only if he is active; Delp is not a fantasy option.

source.label: Audacy WWL: Saints rule out TE Juwan Johnson vs. Bengals (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Jordan Addison (thumb) ruled out vs. Atlanta after missing all three practices
events.detail: Minnesota ruled out Addison, LT Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) and CB Isaiah Rodgers (thigh) on its final report; none practiced all week, per Vikings.com. Atlanta ruled out receivers Zachariah Branch and Jahan Dotson.
events.so_what: Bench Addison for Week 12. Losing the left tackle too dents the Minnesota passing game; the report does not name who absorbs his targets, so do not chase a Vikings WR3 off this alone.

source.label: Vikings.com: Final Vikings vs. Falcons injury report, Week 12 (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Brock Purdy (ankle) out of practice all week and will not play Sunday vs. Seattle, per PFT; Mac Jones to start
events.detail: Purdy did not practice Friday, making it a full week of DNPs on the ankle he hurt in the Week 11 win over Minnesota, and Pro Football Talk reports he will not play against the Seahawks. Mac Jones, who has thrown one pass this season, is in line to start. Receiver Jordan Watkins also sat out Friday. The official game status comes with the final report.
events.so_what: Plan Sunday without Purdy: three DNPs on a day-to-day ankle is a sit even before the official tag. A Purdy manager needs a streaming QB now, and with only 5 bench spots this is a Tuesday-cost question only if the ankle lingers past Week 12. San Francisco pass catchers lose floor with Jones under center.

source.label: Pro Football Talk via Yahoo Sports: Brock Purdy not practicing on Friday, Mac Jones in line to start (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle, foot) ruled out for Sunday vs. Tennessee after missing all three practices
events.detail: Jacksonville ruled Tuten out on its final report after he sat Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. Chris Rodriguez Jr., Ameer Abdullah and LeQuint Allen Jr. are the active backs, with J'Mari Taylor on the practice squad. Receiver Parker Washington (shoulder) is also out.
events.so_what: Rodriguez is the start of the group for Week 12 against Tennessee and a usable RB2/FLEX in a 2-FLEX lineup. He is a one-week rental with Tuten aiming for the Dec. 6 Bears game, so a Tuesday bid should stay small unless Tuten has a setback.

source.label: Jaguars.com: Friday Quick Hits, Tuten out Sunday (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Justin Herbert (concussion) not seen at Friday practice; DJ Uiagalelei in line for his first NFL start vs. New England
events.detail: Herbert missed Wednesday and Thursday and was not spotted during the media-open portion of Friday practice, still in the concussion protocol, per RotoWire. If he does not clear, DJ Uiagalelei makes his first regular-season start against a Patriots team starting Tommy DeVito. Jake Browning was promoted Thursday as cover.
events.so_what: Plan without Herbert. Chargers skill players are downgraded with an undrafted quarterback under center; Kimani Vidal and Keaton Mitchell likely face loaded boxes. The Patriots DEF becomes a streaming option against a first-time starter, and the 35+ points-allowed penalty is unlikely in a backup-vs-backup game.

source.label: RotoWire: Justin Herbert injury, not spotted Friday (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Brock Bowers (ankle) officially Questionable for Sunday night vs. Cleveland after sitting out Friday practice
events.detail: Bowers was limited Wednesday and Thursday, the ankle heavily taped Thursday, then did not practice Friday, per NBC Sports; Klint Kubiak did not say whether Friday was rest. He missed Week 11 at Denver. Michael Mayer is the backup tight end.
events.so_what: Sunday night is the problem: his status resolves after every early game locks. If you start him, have a Sunday-night or Monday tight end you could otherwise use, or accept the zero risk. Tight end is shallow enough here that a healthy Bowers still beats any streamer, so lean start if he is active on the 90-minute inactives.

source.label: NBC Sports: Brock Bowers (ankle) officially questionable (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) ruled out at the Chargers despite opening his IR return window; A.J. Brown also out
events.detail: New England ruled out Doubs, Drake Maye (fibula), A.J. Brown (hamstring) and CB Carlton Davis III on its final report, per Patriots.com. Doubs was limited in two practices after being designated to return. Tommy DeVito starts at quarterback.
events.so_what: Neither Patriots receiver helps you in Week 12. Doubs stays a bench or IR stash; with DeVito at quarterback even a healthy Doubs is a FLEX at best, so he is not worth a roster spot over a startable bench piece with only 5 bench slots.

source.label: Patriots.com: Patriots rule out four, list four questionable for Week 12 vs. Chargers (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Woody Marks cleared from the concussion protocol, no designation for Week 12
events.detail: Marks cleared the protocol and is available for Week 12 after missing Week 11, per NBC Sports. He returns to a backfield that ran through David Montgomery in his absence, with Emari Demercado as the backup.
events.so_what: Startable as a FLEX, but expect a committee with Montgomery rather than his old workload in his first game back. Montgomery managers should temper expectations from his solo-back weeks.

source.label: NBC Sports: Woody Marks (concussion) clears protocol in Wk 12 (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Colston Loveland MRI shows a left knee sprain, not a tear; Bears expected to place him on IR
events.detail: A Friday MRI on the knee Loveland hurt in the first quarter of the Thanksgiving win at Detroit showed a sprain rather than a ligament tear, per multiple reports. The Bears are expected to move him to injured reserve, a minimum four-game absence, and are hopeful he returns before the regular season ends. The move had been reported as expected, not yet made, at publication.
events.so_what: Plan on at least four weeks without him, which covers most of the remaining regular season. Use the IR slot if he is on your roster (IR takes OUT/IR designations) rather than burning one of five bench spots, and stream the position in the meantime.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Loveland suffered knee sprain vs. Lions, likely heading to IR (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Sam Darnold cleared, off the final injury report and set to start vs. the 49ers
events.detail: Mike Macdonald said Friday that Darnold, who missed two games with a quad injury and a cracked rib, is off the injury report after full practices all week and will start Sunday against San Francisco. Seattle ruled out only Quenton Nelson, Abraham Lucas and Jarran Reed. Brock Purdy is out for the 49ers, with Mac Jones starting.
events.so_what: Darnold is a set-and-forget availability call now. He is a pocket passer, so he gets none of the rushing-QB premium; his value is passing volume and the 4-point pass TD, against a 49ers team starting its backup QB.

source.label: Seattle Sports: Sam Darnold will start, Seahawks rule out just 3 vs. 49ers (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Joe Milton throws for 331 yards and three scores as the Eagles erase a 21-point deficit to beat Dallas 39-38; Jalen Hurts out for the season
events.detail: Milton went 21 of 31 for 331 yards and three touchdowns and also ran one in, his third start since replacing Tanner McKee. DeVonta Smith caught touchdowns of 50 and 45 yards, and Jake Elliott won it with a 59-yard field goal with two seconds left. For Dallas, Javonte Williams scored three times and Dak Prescott threw two touchdowns and ran for one. Hurts, sidelined since October with blood clots, is expected to miss the rest of the 2026 season.
events.so_what: Milton's arm talent plus rushing is exactly what the 4-point pass TD and konami rushing premium reward, so he is a streaming QB with a real ceiling, not just a game manager. Smith's value is tied to Milton's deep shots: boom weeks, wider range. Javonte Williams' three scores keep him a locked RB start in a Dallas offense that is still putting up points. Hurts can be dropped in leagues where he is still stashed.

source.label: Philadelphia Eagles: Game Recap, Eagles 39, Cowboys 38 (Nov. 26)

events.headline: Saquon Barkley (stinger) leaves the Thanksgiving win at Dallas and does not return in the second half
events.detail: Barkley, who carried no designation into the game after a left arm/shoulder injury the previous Sunday, was ruled questionable to return with a stinger and stayed out through the second half. Sideline video appeared to show him gesturing at his left hand; the Eagles did not confirm a fracture and kept the stinger designation. It is his second stinger of the season. No post-game diagnosis yet, and Philadelphia has extra rest before its next game. Will Shipley took most of the carries after Barkley left. Dallas Goedert (shoulder) also left the game and did not return, per game reports.
events.so_what: Two arm/shoulder injuries in five days with an unconfirmed hand concern is a real downgrade, not noise. Hold him and watch the first practice report of next week; Eagles backfield depth is worth a speculative add only where bench room allows with only five bench spots.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Saquon Barkley suffers stinger in Eagles' Thanksgiving game vs. Cowboys (Nov. 26)

events.headline: Jalen Royals (left ankle sprain) ruled out of the Chiefs' 13-10 loss at Buffalo; Dalton Kincaid plays
events.detail: Andy Reid said Royals and guard Trey Smith both sprained ankles in Thursday night's rain-soaked loss, decided by Tyler Bass's 57-yard field goal at the gun; Royals left in the second half and was ruled out. Kenneth Walker III did not play. Harrison Butker missed a 46-yarder. Dalton Kincaid returned for Buffalo after missing the previous week with thumb and ankle injuries.
events.so_what: A 13-10 rain game means nobody here scored much, so don't overreact to the box score. Royals' sprain clouds the Chiefs' receiver group heading into the next cycle; wait for Kansas City's first injury report before benching him. Butker's miss from 40-49 costs a point under the banded miss rule. Kincaid back is a TE1-range start again once he gets a full week.

source.label: Arrowhead Pride: Andy Reid gives 2 injury updates after loss to Bills (Nov. 27)

events.headline: Bears beat Detroit 39-35 on a last-second Rome Odunze touchdown; Jahmyr Gibbs runs for 205 yards and three scores in the loss
events.detail: Caleb Williams went 30 of 44 for 345 yards and two touchdowns, both to Rome Odunze (6-87-2 on 9 targets, the winner with three seconds left). D'Andre Swift had 65 rushing yards and a touchdown on 9 carries plus 7-97 receiving on 8 targets, and Kyle Monangai scored twice on the ground. For Detroit, Gibbs ran 21 times for 205 yards and 3 TDs and caught 5 for 47; Amon-Ra St. Brown posted 7-146 on 10 targets, Jameson Williams 6-68, and Sam LaPorta scored on an 11-yard catch. Jared Goff threw for 313 yards, a touchdown and an interception. Chicago is 9-2 and leads the NFC North, per Bleacher Report's box score.
events.so_what: Swift's 162 scrimmage yards came as the receiving back while Monangai took the short touchdowns, so both are startable but Swift has the steadier floor and Monangai the touchdown-dependent one. Odunze's 9 targets keep him a WR2 or FLEX. Williams added just 15 rushing yards, so his week was all passing; the 4-pt pass TD trims what two scores are worth. Gibbs remains a locked RB1.

source.label: Bleacher Report: Bears spoil Gibbs' hat trick, box score and stats (Nov. 26)

events.headline: Blake Corum runs 32 times for 184 yards and a touchdown as the Rams beat Green Bay 26-13; Kyren Williams held to 12 carries
events.detail: Corum set a career high with 184 rushing yards and a score on 32 carries in Wednesday night's win at SoFi Stadium, the most by a Rams player in a game since Todd Gurley in 2018, per the team's recap. Kyren Williams added 46 yards on 12 carries. The Rams are 7-4 and have won five straight. Separately, Tom Pelissero reported Wednesday that Williams has played through turf toe for about a month, per Yahoo Sports.
events.so_what: A 32-to-12 carry split plus a month of turf toe for Williams makes this a real shift while the toe lingers: Corum is a FLEX start and the priority add wherever he is available, and Williams drops to a FLEX rather than a locked RB2 until the carries come back. Corum catches less, so his weeks ride on carries and touchdowns.

source.label: Los Angeles Rams: Game recap, Corum's 184 rushing yards lift Rams over Packers (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Christian Watson (concussion) leaves the loss at the Rams; Jordan Love throws two interceptions
events.detail: Watson left late in the second quarter with a concussion after a hit that got Rams safety Kamren Kinchens ejected, per Yahoo's live coverage. Love finished 17 of 29 for 198 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions, and Green Bay ran only 14 times for 55 yards without Josh Jacobs, per Yahoo. The Packers have a long gap before Week 13.
events.so_what: A concussion puts Watson in the protocol with no timeline, so plan Week 13 without him until he clears; the extra days before Green Bay's next game help. Love's two interceptions cost only a point each here, but a 198-yard night with one touchdown is a streaming floor, not a start. The 14-carry run game is a red flag for whoever carries the ball while Jacobs is out.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Rams ride Blake Corum to Thanksgiving Eve win; Love throws 2 INTs with Watson out (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Steelers release Aaron Rodgers; Mason Rudolph starts Friday vs. Denver
events.detail: Pittsburgh officially released Rodgers on Wednesday, per the NFL transactions wire as reported in Yahoo's live NFL feed, a day after announcing that Rudolph will start Friday's Week 12 game against the Broncos. On Monday Mike McCarthy had said "Aaron Rodgers is our quarterback" after the 19-16 loss to the Eagles. Michael Pittman Jr. (foot), still on injured reserve in his 21-day practice window, was a full participant Tuesday and is expected to be activated for Friday, per NFL.com.
events.so_what: Rodgers is a drop: a release means no Steelers role at all, and any new team would need weeks before he matters. Rudolph is not a streamer against a Denver defense on a short week. Steelers pass catchers keep their roles but lose some efficiency. Pittman is a bench hold until the activation is official, then a FLEX at most in a crowded receiver room. The game is Friday, so decide before the usual Sunday window.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: NFL news live updates, Steelers release Aaron Rodgers (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Kenneth Walker III (groin) ruled out for Thanksgiving at Buffalo after a Wednesday DNP
events.detail: Walker was limited Monday and Tuesday, then did not practice Wednesday and was ruled out for Thursday's game against the Bills, his third straight missed game, per NFL.com. TE Noah Gray (rib) is questionable after full practices. Emmett Johnson has led the backfield in Walker's absence, per CBS Sports.
events.so_what: Out is settled: bench Walker for the Thursday game and do not burn a waiver claim to replace him for a single week if he is otherwise a starter. Emmett Johnson is the volume back again in a game that locks Thursday. Two limited practices before the setback suggest he is close, so hold Walker for Week 13.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Kenneth Walker III to miss Thanksgiving game (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Josh Jacobs (finger) ruled out for Wednesday's game at the Rams, his second straight absence
events.detail: Green Bay ruled out Jacobs, who fractured his right ring finger in Week 9 and had surgery, for Wednesday night in Los Angeles, his second straight missed game, per CBS Sports. Kaleb Johnson has 24 carries over the last two games with Jacobs out, per RotoWire (Nov. 23). Micah Parsons was cleared to make his season debut in the same game.
events.so_what: Settled for this week: Jacobs is out and Kaleb Johnson is a volume start in a Wednesday game, so set it before kickoff tonight. The limited practices this week point to a return after the long gap to Week 13, so hold Jacobs.

source.label: CBS Sports: NFL Thanksgiving injury report, Jacobs out (Nov. 25)

events.headline: Ted Hurst III scores twice as his snap share climbs to 64%, the Buccaneers saying they plan to feature him more
events.detail: Hurst caught 5 of 7 targets for 56 yards and two touchdowns at Detroit on a 64% snap share, his highest since Week 3, and the coach said the team plans to feature him more, per Yahoo's waiver column. He ranked third among Tampa Bay receivers in snaps and routes behind Chris Godwin, per FantasyPros. Jalen McMillan (knee), who had been out, was designated to return from injured reserve on Wednesday, per NFL.com, which threatens the extra snaps.
events.so_what: One two-touchdown game on seven targets is a boom week, not a role yet, and McMillan opening his practice window could take back the snaps that produced it. He is a bench add with upside where you have the spot, and a FLEX only once his target count matches the snap share.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Week 12 fantasy football waiver wire (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Roschon Johnson (ankle) ruled out for Thursday at Detroit
events.detail: Johnson got hurt in the first quarter of the 21-13 win over the Saints yet still ran for 103 yards, per UPI. He did not practice all week and was ruled out for the Thanksgiving game at Detroit, per NFL.com. CBS Sports lists him third on the depth chart behind D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai, who is playing through turf toe; Chicago elevated RB Salvon Ahmed from the practice squad.
events.so_what: Bench Johnson for Thursday. Swift and Monangai split the work in a Thursday game that locks early, and Monangai's turf toe makes Swift the safer FLEX of the two.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Roschon Johnson ruled out (Nov. 25)

events.headline: J.K. Dobbins suspended for Friday's game at Pittsburgh for conduct detrimental; Jonah Coleman in line to start, Tyler Badie designated to return
events.detail: Sean Payton announced a one-game team suspension for "conduct detrimental to the team" and did not elaborate. NFL.com places it on Friday's Week 12 game at the Steelers and notes Dobbins played one snap in the Week 11 win over Las Vegas. Dobbins has 324 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 99 carries, per Yahoo, which expects rookie Jonah Coleman (302 rushing yards in six games) to start. Tyler Badie (thumb) was designated to return from injured reserve and was a full participant in the practice estimation, per NFL.com.
events.so_what: Dobbins is a zero for Week 12: bench him, and do not drop him for a one-game team suspension. Coleman becomes a volume FLEX for the week with the early-down and goal-line work in his hands. Badie returning adds a passing-down body that can trim Coleman's snaps, so Coleman is a FLEX rather than a locked RB2. The game is Friday, so lineups lock earlier than usual.

source.label: NFL.com: News roundup, Kenneth Walker III returns to practice; Broncos suspend J.K. Dobbins (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Dylan Sampson has out-snapped Quinshon Judkins three games running in a Browns backfield now split down the middle
events.detail: Sampson has 77, 69, 48 and 37 scrimmage yards in four games since returning from a knee injury and has out-snapped Judkins in three straight, a 50-50 split, per Yahoo's waiver column. He has at least three catches in all four games, per FantasyPros. Cleveland hosts Las Vegas in Week 12, with Deshaun Watson coming off three straight 300-yard passing games.
events.so_what: Judkins can no longer be treated as a locked RB2: the snaps are even, and Sampson owns the passing-down work, which keeps his floor steady even on days the carries split. Sampson is a FLEX add. Judkins drops to a FLEX who needs a touchdown to return value.

source.label: Yahoo Sports: Week 12 fantasy football waiver wire (Nov. 24)

events.headline: Caleb Douglas commands a 30.3% target share in Miami's second game without Malik Willis
events.detail: With Willis on IR, Douglas has 3-71 on 8 targets against Indianapolis and 2-30 on 10 targets with Kyle McCord at quarterback, per FantasyPros, which put his Week 11 target share at 30.3% despite a couple of drops. He has eight or more targets in each of the last three games, per Yahoo. Miami hosts the Jets in Week 12.
events.so_what: The targets are real and the quarterback is the cap: a first-time starter limits his yardage and touchdown ceiling. He is a volume FLEX in a pinch and a bench hold otherwise, with his value rising as soon as Willis returns.

source.label: FantasyPros: Waiver wire advice for Week 12 (Nov. 24)
